description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases for Git's partial clone and fetch functionalities, including setup procedures, specific test scenarios, and verification commands to ensure correctness of operations related to partial clones, filter inheritance, object fetching, and protocol behaviors.

methods.name: hex_unpack
methods.description: Converts bytes into their hexadecimal representation, useful for inspecting binary pack files.

methods.name: intersperse
methods.description: Inserts a specified string at the start of the string and every 2 characters in the input, often used for formatting hex data.

methods.name: replace_packfile
methods.description: Creates a script to replace the current packfile with a specified one, optionally wrapping it in sideband protocol formatting.
